name: Madame Vastra
oracle_text:
Partner with Jenny Flint (When this creature enters, target player may put Jenny Flint into their hand from their library, then shuffle.)
Madame Vastra must be blocked if able.
Whenever a creature dealt damage by Madame Vastra this turn dies, create a Clue token and a Food token.
blocked_sentences: Madame Vastra must be blocked if able.

needs.what: a static block requirement on the source attacker (509.1c): while this creature is attacking, the defending player must block it with at least one creature if any creature they control is able to (one blocker satisfies it; unlike lure, not every able creature must block). Shape: a static such as `{"effect": "must_be_blocked", "affects": {"self_only": true}}` checked by combat's block-requirement maximisation
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `block_restriction` (with `blockers`, `max_blockers`, `require_all`) only restricts who MAY block, never requires a block; `must_block` / `must_block_any` are one-shot ops that set a requirement on a chosen defending creature on resolution, with no trigger here to hang them on and no way to say 'some creature must block this attacker'; no static_effect imposes a block requirement
